lines.text: Follow the filtrate into the proximal tubule.
The first half of this tube is a hungry mouth, absorbing phosphate and lactate.
It is the kidney's main site of reabsorption: about seventy percent of filtered sodium, chloride and potassium.
It takes back nearly all the amino acids and glucose too.
Further on, the thick ascending limb is impermeable to water.
